depiction_rules.notes: The same dignified father appears throughout. Shackles may be visible in the prison and released for the journey; emotional progression moves from awe to prayer to courageous tenderness.

visual_bible.age: mature adult in his late thirties or early forties
visual_bible.face: long dignified face, expressive dark eyes, straight nose, trimmed beard and moustache
visual_bible.hair: shoulder-length dark wavy hair, partly tied into a simple topknot
visual_bible.clothing: plain ivory dhoti and weathered cream shawl, minimal sacred beads, no royal finery
visual_bible.continuity_markers: vertical Vaishnava tilak, small gold ear studs, simple wrist shackles in prison scenes

never: no changing beard or hair between scenes
do not depict him as elderly
note: Imported character design accepted by delegated judgment for this comparison pass; stanza artwork remains needs-review.
